name: Makino Yuu
source:
Yuu is a second-year student at Toshinoka Academy, the same school that Nozomi and the others go to.

Yuu and Nozomi have been childhood friends ever since he left the countryside where he was born and raised and moved to the city. They had been attracted to each other for a long time, but this summer they officially became a couple.

He is an honor student, with top grades and excellence in both study and sports. Although he can be a little rough around the edges, he is well-regarded by girls for his toned body and relatively good looks. However, when it comes to the all-important aspect of romance, he is a blockhead.

Due to family circumstances, he should be able to do all the household chores himself, but after Nozomi started to take care of him, he found himself leaving all the housework to her before he knew it.

Since becoming a couple, the everyday life he spends with Nozomi has felt even more dazzling...

[Translated from the [url=https://pulltop-latte.jp/PL06/#character]official website[/url]]
